questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence with reported speech.
He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he was just finishing his homework.
He said he would have finished his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the passive voice.
This house _______ by the Romans in the 1st century AD.

Options:

A) was built
B) were built
C) is built
D) was building

Complete the sentence with the correct conditional type.
If I _______ more time, I would learn to play the piano.

Options:

A) had
B) have
C) had had
D) would have

Choose the appropriate discourse marker to complete the sentence.
_______, I've been meaning to ask you about that project.

Options:

A) Anyway
B) Therefore
C) However
D) In conclusion

Select the correct collocation.
She decided to _______ her career in finance for teaching.

Options:

A) give up
B) give away
C) give out
D) give in

Choose the correct dependent preposition.
He is angry _______ not being invited.

Options:

A) because
B) because of
C) due
D) owing to

Select the best word to complete the sentence.
The report was _______ with a lot of technical jargon.

Options:

A) laden
B) filled
C) packed
D) stuffed

Choose the correct form to complete the sentence.
If only I _______ listened to my parents' advice!

Options:

A) had
B) would
C) did
D) had been

Select the appropriate word to complete the phrase.
It's _______ to say that she was surprised.

Options:

A) blunt
B) obvious
C) frank
D) straightforward

Choose the correct sentence with reported speech.
He said, 'I am going to the cinema tonight.'

Options:

A) He said he is going to the cinema that night.
B) He said he was going to the cinema that night.
C) He said he would go to the cinema that night.
D) He said he had been going to the cinema that night.
options: He said he is going to the cinema that night.
He said he was going to the cinema that night.
He said he would go to the cinema that night.
He said he had been going to the cinema that night.
questions.answer: He said he was going to the cinema that night.
